title: 🔢 Simple JavaScript Calculator for Beginners – HTML, CSS & JS 💡
description: This is a simple JavaScript-powered calculator built with HTML, CSS, and JS. It supports basic arithmetic operations (+, -, ×, ÷), percentage, and negation with a clean, responsive UI. Perfect for beginners to learn event handling, DOM manipulation, and dynamic button creation in JavaScript.
